_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name (the form prints 'COUNTY'/'Probate Court'); rendered upper-case, without the word 'County'

docket_no.label: Docket No
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

decedent_name.label: Decedent Name
decedent_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

bond_demand.label: Bond Demand
bond_demand.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

bond_amount.label: Bond Amount
bond_amount.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit

mailing_method.label: Mailing Method
mailing_method.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

attorney_name.label: Attorney Name
attorney_name.expects: full legal name as it should appear on the order
avoid: 'Last, First' order unless the line calls for it

attorney_address.label: Attorney Address
attorney_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

petitioner_name_and_address.label: Petitioner Name And Address
petitioner_name_and_address.expects: an address with: street, city, state, zip
avoid: the state spelled out ('Maine') when an abbreviation fits
a PO box where a physical/legal residence is required

petitioner_interest_nature.label: Petitioner Interest Nature
petitioner_interest_nature.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

petitioner_interest_value.label: Petitioner Interest Value
petitioner_interest_value.expects: a dollar amount, digits and decimal point only
avoid: a '$' character inside the value (the form prints it)
a negative amount unless this line is explicitly a credit
